name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp lets agents search tasks, docs and comments, and manage tasks and team updates in the signed-in workspace. Sign in to a ClickUp account through the browser. The connection can read and write within that account's workspace permissions.

prompts.text: Find my open ClickUp tasks due this week.
Create a ClickUp task for these action items and assign it to me.
Find the latest project update in ClickUp and summarize the open questions.

apps.name: ClickUp
apps.description: Task and document search, task updates, and team comments, over ClickUp's MCP server with browser sign-in.
